It's bullshit. The reason this myth exists is that once you are already buzzed you don't keep track of how much liquor you consume. Safer to stick to beer later in the night when you might drink more without realizing it. So long as you can hold your shit though and avoid consuming anything super sugary, you can drink your beer/liquor in whatever order you please. Personally I like to pair a beer with some whiskey.

As long as you drink the same amount of alcohol in the same time, no, it's not true. But drinking beer usually leads to poor tracking of liquor consumption and therefore leads to drinking more.

On a sidenote, in my experience, beer induced hangovers are worse than, say, vodka induced ones,(for similar amounts of alcohol) but I have no way of saying if it's just perceptual or there is truth about it.
